title: Cat Water Fountain Stainless Steel: 74oz/2.2L Cat Fountain for Drinking
say: Customers find the water fountain functional and appreciate that their cats love drinking from it, while also noting its ultra-quiet operation and ease of assembly and cleaning. However, the reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while the filters work well, some units break within a month, and the pump lasts only 4 months. Moreover, opinions on value for money are divided, with some considering it worth the price while others say it's not worth the money.
